motion: The camera tracks slowly and steadily backwards along the chalk track, low to the ground, ahead of the small grey six-wheeled delivery robot. The robot rolls after it at the same speed, staying the same size in frame, its amber beacon glowing and its torn bunting swaying across its front wheels. Far behind it the long line of people walks steadily along the curving track after it, the old man with his stick and the woman with the blanket trolley at the front. The wind moves through the long grass. Nothing new appears in the grass. Every person keeps their shape. It never stops.
